$comment: Project-scoped hooks, committed on purpose. CLAUDE.md gotcha #14 is the
explanation; these two files are the enforcement. Prose is advisory and
dilutes as context grows, so the rule it records is carried by a hook that
fires on every turn at constant cost instead.
counterfactual-reminder.sh  re-arms the rule on every prompt.
verify-counterfactuals.py   blocks a turn that asserts a counterfactual
with neither a verification citation nor a
hedge. Fails OPEN on any error and blocks at
most once per turn, so it cannot wedge work.
Permissions live in settings.local.json and are untouched by this file.
